The '''BSX-5 Dreadnaught''' was a specialized version of the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
The most famous BSX-5 was the [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']], flagship of [[Darth Jadus]]. It was destroyed while the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] was traveling in it and Jadus was believed to have perished in the explosion.<ref name="TOR" /> While tracking down [[Vyord Yanol]], one of Darth Jadus's servants, an [[Imperial Agent]] accessed a classified document on his computer, detailing the ''Dominator''{{'s}} blueprints.<ref name="TOR" />
